notes.title: Funded in 4 Hours, - New Unlocked STRETCH GOAL!
notes.content:
Hello RuLovers,

We’re thrilled to announce that, thanks to your amazing support, we’ve surpassed €10,000 in less than 24 hours! This incredible milestone has unlocked the first Stretch Goal, which includes:

- Additional scenes for Chapter 01
- Enhanced storytelling and overall gameplay experience

But the journey doesn’t stop here! Every new milestone we reach will make Love RuRu even more exciting and special.

📢 Don’t miss out on the exclusive DLC available only to Kickstarter backers!
This unique content will no longer be available once the campaign ends, so make sure to join in and be part of this one-of-a-kind adventure.

👉 Support the campaign on Kickstarter now and help us bring Love RuRu to life!
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1993416767/love-ruru

notes.title: Join the Journey: Love RuRu Kickstarter Has Launched!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188503/01ee60fac5e9421eb7a3024433bf78164ae33b22.png

The Love RuRu Kickstarter Campaign is LIVE!

I’m thrilled to share that the Kickstarter campaign for Love RuRu is live! After two years of intense work and dedication, we’re taking the next big step toward completing the game.

Kickstarter isn’t just about funding—it’s about bringing you closer to the heart of the project. 

Exclusive rewards like your name in the credits or access to an exclusive DLC are our way of making you an essential part of this journey.

👉 Visit the Kickstarter campaign to support Love RuRu. 

Every pledge brings us closer to delivering a game made with love and care.

Thank you for joining us in making this dream a reality.

notes.title: Step Into the World of Love RuRu
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188503/6bde459e4f19f25d03345a74985382a28a75adbe.png


Welcome Friends!

Here is my first official update on the Steam page for RWorld: Love RuRu! 
Get ready to dive into a thrilling story filled with captivating girls, intense battles, unexpected twists, and of course, unforgettable HOT scenes (over 50, with many more to come in the final version).

To stay up to date, add the game to your wishlist and follow it. By doing so, you'll receive all the updates directly in your Steam library.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3194150



Check Out the Trailer

Haven’t seen it yet? Go watch the trailer now!

[previewyoutube=AHhp8EEg_mg;full][/previewyoutube]


Kickstarter

I've launched the pre-launch campaign on Kickstarter! 
Sign up now to get an exclusive discount and access to special offers when the game is released. 

Don’t miss this unique opportunity!

Share your ideas to improve the game!
